S_detour.text: Give way to whichever robot has already been pushed furthest off its original route.

C_detour_unless_longer.text: Give way to whichever robot has been detoured more, unless the other robot's original journey was more than twice as long — in that case it takes priority instead.

T_detour_cutoff.text: Give way to any robot that has been detoured by more than 2. If both or neither have, give way to the one with the shorter original journey.

U_worse_time.text: Prioritise whichever robot is having a worse time of it.
U_worse_time.code:
def priority(state_a, state_b, id_a, id_b):
    detour_a = state_a['detour_from_optimal']
    detour_b = state_b['detour_from_optimal']
    
    if detour_a != detour_b:
        return id_a if detour_a > detour_b else id_b
    
    constraints_a = state_a['constraints_on_this_robot']
    constraints_b = state_b['constraints_on_this_robot']
    
    if constraints_a != constraints_b:
        return id_a if constraints_a > constraints_b else id_b
    
    alt_a = state_a['alternative_routes_at_conflict']
    alt_b = state_b['alternative_routes_at_conflict']
    
    if alt_a is not None and alt_b is not None and alt_a != alt_b:
        return id_a if alt_a < alt_b else id_b
    
    return id_a if id_a < id_b else id_b

X_heavier_load.text: Give way to whichever robot is carrying the heavier load.
